slides.title: of 15,000 planted showed crop growth in Raya Azebo
Rains failed in May
slides.body: About 10,000 more hectares in Raya Azebo, southern Tigray, were not planted, says a humanitarian assessment seen by Addis Standard.

slides.title: Prices rising
slides.body: Few supplies were reaching Zala Anbesa, eastern Tigray, as of Oct 15; prices rose sharply. FEWS NET projects Crisis-level food insecurity (IPC 3) in parts of Tigray until Jan 2027.

slides.title: Health and displacement
slides.body: The assessment flags a cholera concern in Wag Hamra, Amhara, and says 11,000-13,000 people may remain displaced in Afar. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Keep food and health aid reaching farming families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
